correctness.rationale: Exact diameter set and four face charts established; uniform loss expansion and compactness show s,t=O(epsilon), angle=O(sqrt epsilon). Full boundary-pair invariant-line Jacobian with factor two gives cap/side normal factors and the shared beta-simplex integral; Cauchy normalization yields the explicit constants. The Dirichlet law follows by change of variables and bounded convergence. Exact-distance, exact-flux numerical quadrature passes in dimensions 3–5; computations are corroboration, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: Geometrically natural long-cylinder and short-cylinder extreme chords approach a continuum of nonsmooth diameter rim pairs. The joint type law measures relative end-cap vs side contribution, gives a direct aspect-ratio recovery statistic, and reveals dimension-dependent but aspect-ratio-free Dirichlet shortage fluctuations. These solve a motivated distributional gap not captured by scalar length CDFs, polyhedral vertex cones or smooth isolated-maximizer asymptotics; meaningful geometric structure rather than a single cheap coefficient.
